scope: Existing Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan attractions; official adult/general scopes, no inferred free admission.

entries.name: 香港太空馆
entries.note: 展览厅标准票HKD 10；周三及符合条件的学生免费。天象厅电影须另购HKD 30或40门票，不包含在此价格内。
entries.noteEn: Exhibition halls cost HKD 10; Wednesdays and eligible students are free. Space Theatre shows require a separate HKD 30 or 40 ticket.
entries.sourceTitle: 香港太空馆参观与票务

entries.name: M+
entries.note: 成人HKD 190，特惠票HKD 100；部分公共区域免费。按所选入场时段购票，不把公共区域免费等同全部展览免费。
entries.noteEn: Standard adult admission is HKD 190; concessions HKD 100. Selected public spaces are free. Choose the required admission session.

entries.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
entries.scope: 成人普通门票（指定日期时段）
entries.scopeEn: Regular adult ticket, specified date and session
entries.note: HKD 70普通门票适用于展厅1至7；弹性成人票HKD 90。其他展览以当期购票页面为准。
entries.noteEn: The HKD 70 regular ticket covers galleries 1–7 at the chosen date and time; the adult flex ticket is HKD 90. Check separate exhibition arrangements.
entries.sourceTitle: 香港故宫文化博物馆官方门票

entries.name: 大馆
entries.note: 园区一般参观免费；指定展览、演出或活动可能另收费，应查各活动页面。
entries.noteEn: General site access is free; selected exhibitions, performances or programmes may charge separately.

entries.name: 澳门大赛车博物馆
entries.note: 标准票MOP 80，适用12岁以上、65岁以下访客；优惠资格及指定免费日须另核，不默认套用促销。
entries.noteEn: The standard ticket costs MOP 80 for visitors over 12 and under 65. Check concession eligibility and designated free dates separately.
entries.sourceTitle: 澳门大赛车博物馆官方票务

entries.name: 郑家大屋
entries.note: 免费参观；10:00–18:00，17:30停止入场，周三休馆（公众假期除外）。周末粤语导赏须按官方规则预约。
entries.noteEn: Free admission; 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:30. Closed Wednesdays except public holidays. Reserve weekend Cantonese tours under official rules.
entries.sourceTitle: 澳门旅游局郑家大屋参观资料

entries.name: 龙环葡韵
entries.note: 免费参观；10:00–19:00，18:30停止入场，周一休馆。独立经营的书店、餐饮及活动按各自规则消费。
entries.noteEn: Museum admission is free; 10:00–19:00, last entry 18:30, closed Mondays. Independently operated shops, dining and events have their own terms.
entries.sourceTitle: 澳门文化局龙环葡韵参观资料

entries.name: 台北市立动物园
entries.note: 一般入园票TWD 100；台北市民、学生及其他优惠按证件核验。教育中心TWD 20、游园列车TWD 5另计。
entries.noteEn: General admission is TWD 100. Resident, student and other concessions require eligibility checks. Education Center TWD 20 and shuttle train TWD 5 are separate.
entries.sourceTitle: 台北市立动物园官方票价

entries.name: 台湾自然科学博物馆
entries.note: 展示场TWD 120，包含生命科学厅、人类文化厅及地球环境厅；剧场、温室和科学中心另计。官网公告2026年每周五14:00–17:00展示场免费，出行前复核。
entries.noteEn: Exhibition halls cost TWD 120 and include life science, human cultures and the global environment. Theatres, greenhouse and science center cost extra. The official 2026 Friday 14:00–17:00 free-hall offer requires a pre-visit check.
entries.sourceTitle: 台湾自然科学博物馆官方票价

entries.name: 奇美博物馆
entries.note: 常设展一般票TWD 200；特展、导览与其他体验另计，团体设备租用要求须另查。
entries.noteEn: Permanent exhibition admission is TWD 200. Special exhibitions, guided services and experiences are separate; check group audio-system requirements.
entries.sourceTitle: 奇美博物馆官方参观信息

entries.name: 台湾历史博物馆
entries.note: 展示场全票TWD 100；学生、儿童及其他优惠按证件和当前官方规则核验，团体与家庭票不作为单人成本默认值。
entries.noteEn: Full-price exhibition admission is TWD 100. Verify student, child and other concessions with current official rules; group and family tickets are not the default individual price.
entries.sourceTitle: 台湾历史博物馆官方参观问答

entries.name: 新北市立莺歌陶瓷博物馆
entries.note: 一般门票TWD 80；新北市民、符合条件的学生及其他免票对象须出示证件。体验活动费用另计。
entries.noteEn: General admission is TWD 80. Eligible local residents, students and other exempt visitors must show qualifying documents. Workshops cost extra.
entries.sourceTitle: 莺歌陶瓷博物馆官方门票说明

entries.name: 台北故宫博物院
entries.note: 普通参观券TWD 350；优惠及免票按证件核验，团体导览设备租金另计，不能把优惠票当作所有游客默认票价。
entries.noteEn: Regular northern-branch admission is TWD 350. Concessions and exemptions require qualifying documents; group audio rental is separate.
entries.sourceTitle: 台北故宫博物院官方门票
